name: xiao-s3-expansion
title: Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 + Expansion Board
notes: Plain XIAO ESP32S3 (ESP32-S3R8, 8 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM; not the Sense) on the XIAO Expansion Board Base, whose SD slot is CS D2/GPIO3 on SPI D8-D10 (GPIO 7/8/9): Seeed wiki (Expansion Board, XIAO ESP32S3 pinout), arduino-esp32 XIAO_ESP32S3 variant. The XIAO's LED on GPIO21, active low. Wi-Fi only.
